name: @maestro/tracklens-hook
description: TrackLens Claude Code integration - visual review, annotation, and walkthrough system

scripts.build: bun build:tsc && bun build:ui && bun copy:html
scripts.build:ui: bun run --cwd ../../packages/tracklens-editor build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/tracklens-review-editor build
scripts.copy:html: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp ../../packages/tracklens-editor/dist/index.html dist/index.html && cp ../../packages/tracklens-review-editor/dist/index.html dist/review.html && cp -r ../../packages/tracklens-editor/dist/assets/* dist/assets/ && cp -r ../../packages/tracklens-review-editor/dist/assets/* dist/assets/

author: Maestro
